Terraform by HashiCorp is the de facto standard for infrastructure as code (IaC). It enables you to define, provision, and manage infrastructure across any cloud provider using a declarative configuration language (HCL).
review.terraform.terraform.cloud.and.ent: Terraform Cloud and Enterprise add collaboration features, policy enforcement with Sentinel, and AI-powered drift detection. The platform automatically identifies when real infrastructure deviates from code definitions, helping maintain compliance.
